title: Complimenting an Opponent After a Big Hand
summaryJa: ポーカーテーブルで相手がナイスなプレイをした後、友好的に褒める場面です。ショーダウン後の短い会話を通じて、テーブルでの良好な人間関係を築き、自然な英語の雑談表現を学べます。
segments: You: Nice hand back there. That was a tough spot.
Opponent: Thanks! Your call was good too. I had to sweat it.
You: Yeah, I thought I had you beat. Good luck with the rest of your stack.
Opponent: You too, man. Let's run it good.
